content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the XSK wakeup function triggering multiple interrupts (IRQs) when the application sent a flood of wakeup requests, leading to the posting of multiple NOP Work Queue Elements (WQEs) to the XSK ICOSQ. This resulted in the ICOSQ overflowing, as multiple NOPs were not necessary and increased the queue size unnecessarily. The fix implemented a check to prevent posting a second NOP if one was already in progress, thereby avoiding the overflow issue.
